label: Outdoor gear store
note: A plain export with obvious junk words such as "free", "jobs" and "pdf". Expect phrase negatives for those, and brand and converting terms left alone.

label: Google Ads export with title lines
note: Two title lines, total rows and an "Other search terms" row. Delete the title lines first; real term spend is about $6,183.

label: Same export, title lines removed
note: Ignore the "Other search terms" row and keep the brand term "taskly login" out of any negative.

label: Quebec florist, French export
note: French headers, semicolons and decimal commas. Remove the two title lines and match columns by hand, because totals read with commas as thousands will be 100 times too high.

label: Florist, title lines removed
note: Total cost should be about CAD 1,624. A total of $162,357 means decimal commas were read wrongly.

label: Florist, clean copy
note: The same data with dot decimals. Total spend is about $1,624, with about $639 addressable.

label: Plumber where "repair" is the product
note: Terms with "repair" convert well. Never block "repair"; block words such as "jobs", "salary" and "diy" instead.

label: Enterprise software, few conversions
note: Terms with 6 to 13 clicks and no sales are normal when sales are rare. Do not block them from this evidence, and keep the brand login queries.
